title: Cumulative time in a three-attempt retry example
method: Synthetic attempts each take 2 seconds, with backoffs of 5 then 10 seconds. Cumulative times are 2, 2+5+2=9 and 9+10+2=21 seconds. Queueing, jitter and external uncertainty are excluded; this is a retry-budget exercise, not a product benchmark.
alt: Cumulative time in a three-attempt retry example. First attempt ends: 2 elapsed seconds; Second attempt ends: 9 elapsed seconds; Third attempt succeeds: 21 elapsed seconds. Illustrative values.
